gen-gf-goldman-gf-ubuntu-sans: Wide-set, parenthesis-round letters give Goldman its commanding stance, its lowercase standing tall against the capitals. Ubuntu Sans brings tubular, copper-pipe strokes and big-eyed lowercase, a plain sans that feels thoroughly modern beside it.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-straight line with wide, unclosed terminals, and its tall x-height fills the line. But over a full page that sans stays steady and unhurried, leaving Grandstander to do the shouting.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-yaldevi: Lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, every stroke at one thickness: that is Gugi's whole bold personality. Yaldevi, with an e that opens clearly to the right, handles the sustained reading Gugi would never attempt.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sofia-sans: A clear channel leads into each round letter of Autour One, with no hairline-to-stem shift and barely any step down from capitals. Sofia Sans carries the rounded, uniform feel onward in tall, stencil-cut lowercase.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-readex-p: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height and its terminal tips pointing outward, loose and expressive. Readex Pro handles the steady running text; the heading handles the attitude.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-roboto: Metamorphous is commanding, with generous sidebearings and a high-set midline. Roboto, with generous mouths on its round letters, keeps lengthy text feeling clean and contemporary from line to line.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Noto Sans PhagsPa reads friendly, with c openings you can see through. Its plain sans manner stays gentle across many lines, leaving Eater's dark, wide-spaced menace to push against.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Stubby and loud: Flavors has a towering x-height and diagonals that carry the same heft as its stems. Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its counters open, so lengthy text goes down smoothly.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Audiowide sets ruler-drawn, constant-width lines into tile-like glyphs divided by wide grout, with lowercase tall against its capitals. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki, coiled like tight rope, softens that futuristic edge.
gen-almendra-display-gf-lexend-peta: Literary and ornate, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. Lexend Peta shares that tall x-height, plus unthinned curves and a wide-mouthed c, so both fonts feel generously sized.
